selected_script.angle: Stop rubbing sticky cooking oil film on a tile backsplash with a plain wet dishcloth because it leaves cloudy grease trails; foam the same greasy patch with EcoPure Lab Heavy Duty Degreaser and wipe to a clean, no-residue shine.
selected_script.hook: This backsplash looked clean until the wet cloth just pushed the grease into cloudy streaks.

timeline.0-3s: Extreme close-up of a glossy white tile backsplash behind a stove with sticky yellow-brown cooking oil film around grout lines; a hand scrubs with a plain wet dishcloth and the grease turns into cloudy streaks instead of lifting.
timeline.3-6s: The same wet dishcloth keeps rubbing the same tile area harder, visibly dragging oily residue across the tile and leaving damp smear marks; the hand pauses with slight frustration as the streaks catch the kitchen light.
timeline.6-10s: EcoPure Lab Heavy Duty Degreaser enters naturally in the same handheld shot; the recognizable white trigger spray bottle with orange and dark navy label sprays light foam onto the same greasy tile patch, the foam loosens the oil, a gray cloth wipes it away, and the camera tilts to show the cleaned tile next to one small untouched greasy edge for credible before-after proof, ending with a casual spoken CTA: “Try it on your greasy kitchen spots.”

scenes.promptText: Create one complete approximately 10-second vertical TikTok-style UGC cleaning ad in 9:16, realistic handheld phone-shot style in an ordinary American kitchen, natural daylight, slight hand movement, no studio polish. Timeline: 0-3s: Start with an extreme close-up of a credible cleaning pain on the same surface: sticky yellow-brown cooking oil film and specks around the grout on a white tile backsplash directly behind a stovetop. A familiar ordinary method fails: a hand uses a plain wet dishcloth to rub the greasy tile, but the grease does not lift; it turns into cloudy streaks and damp oily trails. Do not show the product yet. 3-6s: Continue the same failed method on the exact same greasy patch. The hand rubs harder with the wet dishcloth, visibly dragging residue across the tile, smearing the oil wider, leaving hazy streaks that catch the light; the motion feels tiring and mildly frustrating but realistic. 6-10s: The EcoPure Lab Heavy Duty Degreaser enters naturally from the side into the same shot, not as a perfect packshot. Use the provided product reference images as the exact product identity: white molded plastic trigger spray bottle, short rectangular white nozzle, ribbed white screw collar, molded finger grooves on the bottle side, rounded rectangular lower bottle body, glossy orange front label with EcoPure Lab logo near the top, large Heavy Duty Degreaser title, Foaming Action subtitle, small stovetop image panel, dark navy bottom band with 10.1 fl oz / 300 ml cue, correct color, label placement, shape, material, proportions, and visible structure. The hand sprays a few pumps of realistic light foam onto the same greasy tile patch; foam clings briefly and loosens the oil without magical cleanup or exaggerated chemical effects. A gray cloth wipes through the foam once or twice, revealing a clean tile surface. End with a credible result proof: the camera tilts close to show the cleaned tile next to a small untouched greasy edge or corner for natural before-after contrast, then the bottle rests nearby with label visible. Light casual spoken CTA only: “Try it on your greasy kitchen spots.” No UI, no subtitles, no stickers, no text overlays, no watermarks, no floating icons, no invented accessories, no extra packaging unless already in the reference, no product drift, no color changes, no green or yellow label, no bacteria-killing claims, no disinfectant claims, no giant poster headline, no before-after split graphic, no magical instant disappearance.
